UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's public profile and subscription status.

photoURL.description: URL for the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the user profile was created.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Represents a category or sub-category for content.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent category. Null for top-level categories.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the category was created.

displayStyle.description: The display style for content items in this category.

fileTypes.description: A short string representing the file types in the category (e.g., 'PSD, AI').

order.description: A number used for ordering categories.

ContentItem.title: Content Item
ContentItem.description: Represents a piece of content with a title, image, and download link or prompt.

title.description: The title of the content item.

downloadUrl.description: URL for the content's download link. Used for style1 and style2.

prompt.description: The prompt text to be copied. Used for style3.

instructions.description: Instructions on how to use the prompt. Used for style3.

videoUrl.description: URL for a video link. Used for style4.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the item was created.

order.description: A number used for ordering content items.

screenshots.description: An array of URLs for screenshot images. Used for style5.

appVersion.description: The version of the application/item. Used for style5.

Suggestion.title: Suggestion
Suggestion.description: Represents a design or code improvement suggestion generated by the AI tool.

inputDesign.description: The design input used to create the suggestion, could be a link, code sample, etc.

inputCode.description: The code input used to create the suggestion.

feedback.description: The feedback provided by the AI suggesting possible improvements.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the suggestion was created.

SubscriptionDialogConfig.title: Subscription Dialog Config
SubscriptionDialogConfig.description: Configuration for the subscription pop-up dialog.

description.description: The main text/description of the dialog.

link.description: The URL for the subscription button.

enabled.description: Whether the dialog is active or not.

ShareLinkConfig.title: Share Link Config
ShareLinkConfig.description: Configuration for the app sharing link.

text.description: The text to be shared along with the URL.

enabled.description: Whether the share link is active or not.

primaryColor.description: The primary color for the light theme in HSL format without the hsl() wrapper (e.g., '222.2 47.4% 11.2%').

primaryColorDark.description: The primary color for the dark theme in HSL format without the hsl() wrapper (e.g., '222.2 47.4% 11.2%').

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a push notification sent to all users.

description.description: The body text of the notification.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the notification was created.

SubscriptionRequest.title: Subscription Request
SubscriptionRequest.description: Represents a user's request to subscribe.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the request was created.

definition.description: Stores AI-powered suggestions specific to a user. This path enforces user-based ownership.  Includes denormalized `userId` for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the suggestion.

params.name: suggestionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the suggestion.

definition.description: Stores all categories, including main and sub-categories.
Stores content items within a specific category.
Stores the global configuration for the subscription dialog. There should only be one document with the ID 'subscriptionDialog' in this collection.
Stores the global configuration for the app share link. There should only be one document with the ID 'shareLink' in this collection.
Stores the global configuration for the app theme. There should only be one document with the ID 'theme' in this collection.
Stores all global notifications sent to users.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed for scalability and security. User-specific data like 'Suggestion' is nested under user documents for strict ownership (`/users/{userId}/suggestions/{suggestionId}`). The `categories` collection stores all content sections in a flat structure; sub-sections are defined by a `parentId`, allowing a flexible hierarchy. Content items are stored in a sub-collection (`/categories/{categoryId}/items/{itemId}`), which simplifies querying and enables granular security rules based on the parent category. A single-document collection `appConfig` is used for global settings like the subscription dialog. A new collection 'subscriptionRequests' is added to store user subscription requests publicly.
